description: This file defines a PHP class 'TimezonesAPI' as part of the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin API. It provides an endpoint to list available timezones, optionally filtered by name, including their label and offset.

classes.name: TimezonesAPI
classes.description: A PHP class that provides an API endpoint to retrieve a list of timezones, optionally filtered by timezone name, including their display label and offset.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list timezones, filtering by optional 'timezoneName' parameter, sorts by offset, and returns collection results.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request, validating the optional 'timezoneName' query parameter.
